note: Dune-motion vectors, Landsat 8/9 OLI pan (15 m), November scenes 2013-11-07 to 2025-11-08, 480 m windows; one point per 240 m, ONLY where motion is detected (speed > 2.45 x calibrated sigma; median detection limit 0.45 m/yr). Areas without points: motion below the detection limit, masked non-dune surface, or outside the box. heading_deg = direction of motion (0 = N, clockwise). quality = median phase-correlation peak x share of pairs used (0-1). Computed by pipeline/02_tracking_and_dunes.ipynb.
